title: Customer service advisor
description: Location: Hemel Hempstead Pay: 12.71 per hour + holiday pay Hours: Monday to Friday, shifts between 9:00am and 6:30pm Start Date: 19th October 2026 Contract: Temp to Perm Are you looking for temp work in Hemel Hempstead and available to start from 19th October 2026? we're looking for three customer service professionals to support Customer Service Advisor project with a fantastic and well-established client of ours. They're well known within the local community for their great team environment, supportive atmosphere and excellent training. We've placed numerous people with them on temporary projects over the years, and for many it has been a great opportunity to gain office-based experience, whilst for others it's simply been a good way to keep busy and earn some extra money. In this role, you'd typically be taking inbound calls, processing payments and dealing with customer queries, following a straightforward and largely scripted processes. Full training will be provided on how to structure these calls and use their phone and computer system too. The company is PCI compliant, so you won't have any exposure to customers' card information. As part of this role, you'd be working during core hours, Monday to Friday, with shifts such as: 9am to 5pm / 9.30am to 5.30pm / 10am to 6pm / 10.30am to 6.30pm This is an office-based role in the Apsley area of Hemel Hempstead, and remote working isn't an option. With this in mind, you'll need to be able to get to the office each day. Please be aware mobile phones aren't permitted within the Contact Centre and would need to be stored in a designated locker during working hours. This is worth bearing in mind when considering the role. We're initially looking for people who are available for a few weeks of work, although there will likely be opportunities for some people to continue with the company on a longer-term basis too. The role will be weekly paid whilst temping, paying 12.71 per hour + holiday pay accrual. Due to the industry of this company, you'll also be required to undergo a credit check and DBS check. These will be arranged and paid for by an outsourced service provider if you're successfully offered the role, and you'll just need to complete some forms and provide proof of ID and address. We're ideally looking to book short telephone chats/interviews, followed by a few days to a week for the necessary compliance checks. This means we're hoping to have people starting from 19th October 2026. Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment. Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing, and IT Helpdesk/IT support.

title: Call Centre Advisor
description: Call Centre Operative We are seeking a professional Call Centre Operative to join our client working in property debt collection. In this role, you will handle inbound and outbound calls, assisting customers with account inquiries, discussing repayment options, and guiding them toward resolving outstanding property-related balances. Key Responsibilities: - Handle Inbound & Outbound Calls: Answer customer inquiries regarding debt balances and proactively reach out to debtors to discuss payment options and deadlines. - Provide Accurate Information: Explain account statuses, payment methods, and the debt recovery process clearly and professionally. - Update Account Records: Document all phone interactions, agreement details, and customer notes accurately in the database during or immediately after each call. - De-escalate Situations: Manage sensitive or stressful conversations with patience, empathy, and professionalism. The successful candidate will have: - Previous experience in a customer service, or call centre environment. - Strong verbal communication and negotiation skills. - Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure or when dealing with frustrated callers. - Proficient computer skills for navigating databases and updating records. Benefits: - 25 days holiday plus 1 additional day for every full year of service. - Discretionary bonus. - On-site parking. - Company Pension. - Company social events. - Death in service. - Progression opportunities. Despite our best efforts it is not always possible to respond to every application individually due to the high volume of responses we receive on each vacancy. Only candidates who are short listed will be contacted for this particular role and if you have not heard from us within 7 days please assume that you have not been successful. However, we will keep your details on our database, and will contact you when other suitable positions become available.

title: Service Administrator

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, thrives in a busy environment, and takes pride in delivering exceptional service to clients and colleagues alike. As the first point of contact for support, you'll play a crucial part in ensuring service requests are handled efficiently, engineers are scheduled promptly, and clients receive a seamless experience. Key Responsibilities In this role, you will support the day to day running of the operations department, including: - Monitoring and responding to emails in the service inbox - Answering incoming calls to the Service Desk - Logging client requests across internal and external systems - Scheduling engineer visits and coordinating their attendance - Closing completed jobs on the internal job management system - Booking couriers and tracking shipments - Managing the return of faulty equipment to suppliers or manufacturers - Sending Welcome Packs to newly onboarded clients About You The ideal candidate will bring a positive attitude, strong organisational skills, and a commitment to excellent customer service. You will be: - Experienced in a similar service led or administrative role - Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail - Confident managing multiple tasks and prioritising effectively - An excellent communicator, both written and verbal - Friendly, approachable, and professional when dealing with clients - Reliable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast paced office environment What's in It for You? - Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm working pattern - 23 days holiday plus bank holidays, rising with length of service - Supportive, friendly, and collaborative team culture - Pension scheme - Company Christmas bonus - On site parking - Regular company events - Full training provided with ongoing development opportunities

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Customer Service Advisor Location: Watford Salary: 25000 per annum Hours: Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week Working hours: Flexible start between 8:00am-9:00am, finishing between 4:00pm-5:00pm with a 30-minute lunchbreak Contract: Permanent Start: Immediate About the Opportunity We are delighted to be recruiting for a Customer Service Advisor to join a well-established organisation that is currently going through an exciting period of growth. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing team at an important time for the business. As a Customer Service Advisor, you will become an integral part of the customer service team, providing a high-quality and professional service to clients throughout the full customer journey - from onboarding and quotations through to reporting, invoicing and managing day-to-day communications. You will play an important role in ensuring customers receive an excellent level of service, working closely with internal departments and external clients to ensure projects are delivered efficiently and effectively. This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and expanding organisation where you can make a genuine contribution to the customer experience, develop your skills and build a long-term career within a supportive team environment. If you are organised, customer-focused and thrive in a busy environment, we would love to hear from you. The Role As a Customer Service Advisor, you will be responsible for delivering an excellent customer experience while working closely with internal teams and external clients. Key responsibilities will include: - Supporting the team with the administration associated with onboarding new clients and the continued delivery of excellent customer service. - Managing and responding to incoming client communications via email and telephone in a timely and professional manner. - Acting as a first point of contact for client queries and resolving issues wherever possible. - Escalating and coordinating queries with the appropriate internal teams where required. - Inputting and maintaining accurate customer information within LIMS and other internal systems. - Liaising with customers regarding sample paperwork, COCs and purchase orders. - Preparing accurate, fit-for-purpose quotations within the approved authority level. - Coordinating logistical queries and arrangements where required. - Managing subcontract laboratory services when necessary. - Liaising with analytical teams to ensure customer projects are delivered successfully. - Coordinating the delivery of customer receipts, reports and invoices. - Providing accurate client information and updates to the wider team. - Working with the SCSA and Customer Service Manager as part of a continual improvement process. - Building and maintaining strong, professional relationships with clients and internal stakeholders. - Processing media orders and developing knowledge of sampling techniques. - Completing result uploads, calculations and accurate data entry. - Checking data entry and calculations completed outside of the LIMS system. - Supporting the wider customer service function as required. These duties are not exhaustive and should not be interpreted as a complete definition of the role. About You We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, organised and confident communicating with a wide range of people. You will be comfortable working in a busy environment, managing competing priorities and maintaining a high level of accuracy. You will ideally have: - Previous experience in a customer service role - Experience working in a fast-paced environment - desirable. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. - A professional and confident telephone manner. - Strong customer service and interpersonal skills. - Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills. - The ability to manage your own workload effectively. - A collaborative, "one team" approach. - Excellent attention to detail. - Strong numerical and accurate data-entry skills. - Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office 365, Excel and Word. - The ability and willingness to learn and use various in-house systems and processes. - A positive and adaptable approach to change. - Flexibility and the ability to adapt to changing priorities. Company Benefits In addition to joining a well-established and growing organisation, the successful candidate will receive the following benefits: - Annual Leave: 22 days' holiday per year, plus bank holidays. - Healthcare: Healthcare provision. - Death in Service: Life cover equivalent to four times your annual salary. - Company Pension: Access to a company pension scheme. - Free on-site parking Interested?
